meta.name: tui-feedback-loop
meta.description: Harness-first workflow for evaluating and improving terminal UIs through real interaction. Use this whenever the user wants to review a TUI experience, compare before/after behavior, identify UX friction, validate navigation or filtering flows, inspect visual stability, or turn observed interaction problems into concrete follow-up tests and improvement recommendations. Prefer this skill any time a TUI should be exercised through a reproducible PTY/session harness instead of only reading code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过真实交互发现终端界面问题并给出改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发终端界面,想通过真实操作发现体验问题并改进。
copy.tagline_en: Spot terminal UI problems through real interaction and turn them into improvements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing terminal UIs and want hands-on feedback to improve the experience.

howto.what: Claude 会实际运行你的终端界面程序(而不是只看代码),模拟真实用户操作并记录运行状态,然后根据证据指出哪里不好用、哪里出错,并产出测试机会和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你想审查终端界面(即命令行里的可视化程序)、比较改动前后的行为、验证导航或过滤流程等,或把发现的交互问题变成回归测试和改进建议时。

say.text: 用 PTY harness 跑一下这个终端工具,看看筛选功能哪里难用。
say.note: Claude 会实际运行程序并带证据指出问题。

say.text: 把我改动前后的启动体验各跑一遍,告诉我差别。
say.note: 它会对比两次会话的启动过程并总结差异。

say.text: 像真实用户一样操作这个终端界面,把发现的问题变成回归测试思路。
say.note: 它会将交互卡点转化为具体的测试场景。

howto.what_en: Claude will run your TUI in a harness, act like a user, record states, cite evidence for UX issues and errors, and offer tests plus improvement ideas.
howto.when_en: Whenever you want to review a TUI experience, compare before/after behavior, validate navigation/filtering flows, or turn interaction problems into regression tests and improvement suggestions.

say_en.text: Use the PTY harness to check this terminal's filter UX for rough spots.
say_en.note: Claude will run the app and cite evidence for UX issues.

say_en.text: Run the app before and after my changes and compare the startup experience.
say_en.note: It replays both sessions and reports differences.

say_en.text: Interact with this TUI like a user and turn issues into regression-test ideas.
say_en.note: The skill converts friction into concrete test scenarios.
